description: Shows the user and factory presets of the module immediately to its left and loads them by click or by voltage; it goes immediately to the right of that module

params.text: Reads the preset folders of the module to the left again, picking up presets saved since the last read

inputs.text: Selects a preset within the open folder, 0.1V per preset, and loads it whenever the selection changes

notes: the left column of the display walks the folders, with two dots for the folder above, and clicking a name in the right column loads that preset into the module to the left
nothing is listed until there is a module immediately to the left; the display reads that module's user and factory preset folders
